name: Lourival Monaco
title: Research Assistant Professor of Digital Innovation and Entrepreneurship
bio: Research Assistant Professor leading venture-studio methods and industry transformation in the agrifood system. Serves as Research Manager at Purdue's DIAL Ventures, directing applied research connecting agrifood companies with startup innovation. Holds a PhD in Business Administration, MS in Agronomy and Crop Science, and MBA.

name: Geoffrey Lentner
title: Data Science and HPC Specialist
bio: Data scientist and HPC expert with academic background in Astrophysics. Provides advanced user support on data science, data processing, and high-performance computing applications. Prolific builder of tools and automation, consulting with faculty and students on computational projects.
